messages:
erin (support): Heads-up: two customers reported JSON mode outputs are malformed after the rwinf/llama-3.2.1 rollout last night. Parse errors in downstream pipelines. Attaching sample response we captured.

olivia (support): Which customers + severity? Are they on shared or dedicated capacity?

erin (support): Affected: AcmeCorp (P1, dedicated) and BetaFin (P2). Both hit with invalid JSON: trailing commas and sometimes incomplete objects. Repro steps: POST /v1/generate with mode=\"json\", stream=false, schema expecting {title,metadata}.

matt (eng-ml): Can you paste raw response for one failure? Need to see exact characters. Also: any changes to tokenizer or canonicalization in 3.2.1?

erin (support): Raw response (truncated):

{"title":"Q1 report","metadata":{"author":"alice",},"sections":[{"heading":"Intro"},{"heading":"Numbers",}],}

Client error: \"SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 45\". Correlation id: req_acme_0a1b2c.

sasha (sre): No infra deploys except the model rollout. Deploy log: deploy-bot kicked rwinf/llama-3.2.1 at 1769410042. No autoscaler or middleware changes.

deploy-bot: Deployment rwinf/llama-3.2.1 -> production completed (canary 10% -> 100%) at 1769410042.

david (customer-success): AcmeCorp paused ingestion and asked for rollback. They want assurance of no data loss and a short maintenance window.

matt (eng-ml): Initial hypothesis: model's generation behavior changed for punctuation around small objects/arrays, producing extra commas. Could be prompt-template tweak or model tokenization difference. Two mitigations: 1) per-tenant routing rollback to 3.2.0 (fast), 2) temporary API-layer sanitizer to repair common JSON issues (stopgap).

matt (eng-ml): Example naive sanitizer we can drop in at the API edge (js):

function sanitizeJsonString(s){
  // Remove trailing commas before } or ]
  s = s.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1');
  // Attempt parse, if still fails do minimal fixes then return string
  try { JSON.parse(s); return s; } catch(e) { return s.replace(/,\s*$/,''); }
}

olivia (support): Customer agreed to rollback + temporary sanitizer. They want 15m notice before switch.

sasha (sre): Applying per-tenant routing override for acme-cust-id -> rwinf/llama-3.2.0 now. ETA ~10m. No DB changes so no data-loss risk. Also enabling sanitizer in front of response for 1 hour and logging repairs to /var/log/redwood/sanitized.json.

deploy-bot: Routing override applied for acme-cust-id -> rwinf/llama-3.2.0 at 1769502200.

sasha (sre): Verified test request to 3.2.0 returns valid JSON. AcmeCorp resumed ingestion. BetaFin will be contacted about a scheduled rollback.

david (customer-success): AcmeCorp confirmed pipeline green. They requested a postmortem and prevention plan.

matt (eng-ml): Follow-ups: (1) eng-ml to reproduce and isolate root cause using raw tokens (assigned to matt), (2) add structured-output regression tests in rollout pipeline, (3) consider adding canonical serializer layer or stricter prompt constraints before future rollouts.

erin (support): I'll update the support ticket and customer. Leaving follow-up tasks for eng/sre. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
